Each of the 6 sickening.events ticket pages carries Event JSON-LD whose date/venue/doors time matches its bearracuda.com page (start times 21:00 / 21:30, end times 02:00 / 03:00). openQuestions.q: Configured URL #2 (Eventbrite organizer 21867032189) has had 0 upcoming events on 2026-09-07, 09-09 and 09-10 — Bearracuda now sells via sickening.events, Ticketmaster and on-page Venmo. Keep it as a dead-door canary, or repoint the second URL at nothing?

Denver 17 ticketing is Ticketmaster only (HTTP 401 bot-wall to curl); the scraper cannot read a price. Is cover: null acceptable for it, or should the Facebook event (RSVP Link) be read as a fallback?

Which name should the diff tool key on — the site h1 / homepage row ("Portland Oct", "Seattle💦") or the party name recorded here as title ("Bearracuda Portland: DICK OR TREAT")? The run titles are brand-prefixed h1s ("BEARRACUDA: Portland NYE"); shortName carries the h1 so either key can be matched.
